headline: EM-DAT Archive v1.1 vs v2.0 disagree on deaths for 2023-0636-AFG
summary: Verified pairwise on freshly downloaded Dataverse primaries: v1.1 tab (file id 28130) vs v2.0 xlsx (file id 38893). Among 1,602 earthquake rows sharing DisNo., 433 rows differ materially on deaths and/or CPI-adjusted damage (426 dam_adj-only, median |Δ|≈2.95%; 7 death revisions). Hero row 2023-0636-AFG: Total Deaths 2445 (v1.1) vs 1480 (v2.0), Δ965. Same-institution archive vintage — press/catalog-revision annex only.
